description: This file manages popout window functionalities in the Mattermost web application, including opening, messaging, and identifying popout windows for threads, RHS plugins, and help pages. It also handles communication between desktop and browser environments.

methods.name: registerRHSPluginPopoutListener
methods.description: Registers a listener for RHS plugin popout events based on plugin ID.

methods.name: popoutThread
methods.description: Opens a thread in a popout window and sets up message handling for reply posts.

methods.name: popoutRhsPlugin
methods.description: Opens a RHS plugin in a popout window with specified parameters.

methods.name: popoutRhsSearch
methods.description: Opens a search results page in a RHS popout window with specified search terms and filters.

methods.name: popoutHelp
methods.description: Opens the help page in a popout window.

methods.name: sendToParent
methods.description: Sends a message to the parent window, handling desktop and browser environments.

methods.name: onMessageFromParent
methods.description: Sets up a listener for messages from the parent window, handling desktop and browser environments.

methods.name: isPopoutWindow
methods.description: Checks if the current window is a popout window.

methods.name: isThreadPopoutWindow
methods.description: Checks if the current window is a specific thread popout window.

methods.name: canPopout
methods.description: Determines if the current environment supports opening popouts.
